summary: The blocking finding is valid: the spec must state how loop review is wired into the active impl review path, otherwise implementation could change unused code only.

items.title: Spec targets an unused impl review loop
items.rationale: Verified source shows current runReview uses buildImplReviewPrompt and runImplReview directly, while runLoopReview is not called. The spec needs an active-path integration requirement.
items.evidence: src/flow/commands/review.js runReview builds buildImplReviewPrompt, calls flow.impl.review.propose, then passes reviewOutput to runImplReview; rg finds runLoopReview only at its definition and export.
